notes.title: Super Neptunia™ RPG NOW AVAILABLE on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/862f166d627fa6cc059be7fb1f4c1e0db67aef45.png[/img]

[b]Hop into Gamindustri's 2D world today![/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016960/Super_Neptunia_RPG/][i][b]Super Neptunia™ RPG[/b][/i][/url] is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam® with a [b]WEEKLONG 20% discount[/b]! The Steam version also includes [b]English, French, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.[/b]

Steam users can purchase the game for [b]20% off ($39.99)[/b] for the first week of launch! There is also a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11354/Super_Neptunia_Deluxe_Edition_Bundle______Ensemble_Edition_Deluxe/?snr=1_5_9__403][b]Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack)[/b][/url] priced at a [b]permanent 10% discount[/b].

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1055680/Deluxe_Pack______Ensemble_Deluxe/?snr=1_5_9__405][b]Deluxe Pack[/b][/url] will have its own weeklong 20% launch discount and includes:

[list]
[*] Character Art Collection 
[*] Background Art Collection 
[*] Rough Art Collection 
[*] PC Wallpapers (x2) 
[*] Mobile Wallpapers (x5)
[*] Official Soundtrack
[/list]

[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082574/Enchanted_Weapon_Set_____Ensemble_Armes_Enchantes/?snr=1_5_9__405][b]Enchanted Weapon Set[/b][/url]
